auth.heading: Discover what's happening on campus.
auth.signupDescription: Create your account to save events, personalize your feed, and get recommendations for your school.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to access your saved events and personalized feed.
auth.forgotPasswordDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.forgotPasswordSent: If that email is registered, you'll receive a reset link shortly.
auth.resetPasswordDescription: Enter a new password for your account.
auth.resetPasswordSuccess: Your password has been updated. You can sign in with it now.
auth.resetPasswordInvalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.resetPasswordFailed: Unable to update your password. Please request a new reset link.
auth.signupConflict: Unable to create account — please try a different email
auth.confirmationRequired: Account created! Check your email for a confirmation link, then log in.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.termsNotice: By continuing, you agree to the platform terms and event community guidelines.
auth.consentHeading: Data, safety, and your campus feed
auth.consentDescription: How we keep event discovery safe and useful for students.
auth.consentControlData: You control your profile data and can update or delete your account anytime.
auth.consentNoSell: We do not sell your data to third parties or data brokers.
auth.consentAnonymized: We may review anonymized usage patterns to improve event recommendations.
auth.consentAgreeTerms: I agree to the platform terms and acceptable use policy for campus event discovery.
auth.consentSubscribeUpdates: Subscribe to occasional updates about new features and campus event highlights.

onboarding.safetyTitle: Welcome to your campus events home.
onboarding.safetyDescription: We help you discover what is happening around your school and connect with communities that match your interests.
onboarding.safetySaveEvents: Save events, track deadlines, and quickly filter by what matters to you.
onboarding.safetySafeguards: Community and safety safeguards help keep events high quality and trustworthy.
onboarding.doneDescription: Your personalized campus feed is ready. Time to discover what's happening around you.
onboarding.emailDigestTitle: I want to receive emails of new events
onboarding.emailDigestDescription: Get a 10:30 AM roundup when new events are added for your school.

onboarding.gooseStep4: Gotcha, and which faculty are you in?
onboarding.gooseStep5: Last thing: want the daily scoop when new events land at your school?
